documents.text: Total revenue for fiscal year 2024 was $4.82 billion, an increase of 18% compared to $4.08 billion in fiscal 2023. The growth was driven primarily by expansion in the cloud services segment, which grew 34% year over year. Gross margin improved to 61.2% from 58.7% in the prior year, reflecting a favorable shift toward higher-margin subscription revenue.

documents.source: DemoCorp 10-K FY2024, Consolidated Statements of Operations
documents.text: Net income for fiscal 2024 was $612 million, compared to $498 million in fiscal 2023. Diluted earnings per share were $3.41 versus $2.79 in the prior year. Operating expenses totaled $2.34 billion, with research and development accounting for $890 million.

documents.source: DemoCorp FY2024 Earnings Call, CFO prepared remarks
documents.text: For fiscal 2025, management expects revenue in the range of $5.5 billion to $5.7 billion, representing growth of approximately 14% to 18%. The company anticipates continued margin expansion driven by operating leverage in the cloud segment, and expects full-year operating margin between 16% and 18%.

Our business is subject to intense competition from larger, better-capitalized competitors. A significant portion of revenue is concentrated among our top ten customers, who collectively accounted for 41% of total revenue in fiscal 2024. The loss of one or more major customers could materially harm our results. We are also exposed to foreign currency risk, as 38% of revenue is denominated in non-US currencies.

As of the end of fiscal 2024, the company held $1.9 billion in cash and cash equivalents and $620 million in long-term debt. Cash generated from operating activities was $980 million during the year. The company maintains an undrawn $500 million revolving credit facility.
